HIST_REP_SM.note: SM count of the IDENTICAL histogram replication target, Int32 families only (fused two-stat 8-bit, shared-Int32 one-byte ladder, wide 8-bit, launch_one_byte/launch_hist2_one_byte in HIST_SMEM_SHARED2_I32). Float binary/half-byte families, level quantize and multi-GPU shards keep the pinned 32. Per-row Int32 quantize + associative atomics: no bit moves; host unchanged. Default device (0, device SMs x 2) in IDENTICAL; arm pinned32 (`MOJOLEARN_TREES_HIST_REP_SM_OFF`) is the old pinned replication_for. Grid run ge123e6f9 (NVIDIA L40S + AMD MI325X, full board data, one scored run per arm); PROMOTED to the IDENTICAL default by lane/grid-flips-1 2026-10-08 (Andrew 13:00Z); numbers at the declaration and in docs/apple-fast/EXPERIMENTS.md.
HIST_REP_SM.prune_note: target = blocks-per-SM x SMs: BPSM=4 alone == SM=64 and SM64+BPSM4 == SM128 (merged, lane/grid-prune 2026-10-07). Arms: 64 (2x pinned), device (2 per SM, the CatBoost formula), device_bpsm4 (4 per SM, define value 1). 128 dropped: within 10% of device on NV (142 SMs). Not on gbdt-ordered (no replication_int32_for caller on the ordered route).

PREDICT_ROW_OUTPUTS.note: ordered forest predict (FOREST_ROUTE=0, T34 off): one thread per row walks each tree once and keeps up to 8 per-output register sums; same per-output tree-order forest_add chain and identical_div; inert under FOREST_ROUTE=1|2 and T34; host unchanged

IF_BUILD_TPB.note: threads per tree block of build_isolation_trees_global_kernel; min/max ties to lower position and integer scans make the tree width-independent; 512 widens shared scratch to 43 KB; host unchanged

GBDT_APPLY_WIDE.note: pre-existing fam2-gbdt F4 candidate (64 same-depth oblivious trees per launch, register sum in tree order), registered for the grid by lane trees-small; reaches oblivious-tree predict only (mixed-depth ensembles keep the four-tree grouping)
